handoff.objective: Formalize the user-supplied seed (context.md) into at most two schema-complete proposals bound to RQ-RELN-001 (goal GOAL-RELN-001; proposals only, no lane opened): (1) a measurement-class proposal defining the integer dependency lattice L of augmented Semaev relation rows (c_i, a_i, b_i) with the modular constraint c_i.l - a_i - b_i x = 0 mod n, the exact object (which lattice: the left kernel over Z of the augmented matrix, its modular reduction, or the row lattice, with the determinant and dimension stated), the statistic lambda_1(L) versus the Gaussian-heuristic prediction det(L)^{1/d} sqrt(d/2 pi e), a matched null (random relations of the same weight and modulus, and a random-curve null at the same p), a decay parameter, and the pre-registered decision rule for calling a curve or tree representation anomalous; and (2) optionally a control-class or mechanism-class proposal on whether anomalously short dependencies could lower effective relation-generation entropy, stated conditionally with the exact quantity (entropy of what distribution, measured how) and what it would and would not imply for ECDLP cost.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the dependency lattice of Semaev relation systems on prime-field curves carries structure beyond random modular linear algebra, and whether such structure is even in principle convertible into reduced relation-collection cost.
